name: Independent Assumption Audit Registry
purpose: Stress-test whether theorem packages contain hidden assumptions not declared in RFPR.

required_checks.description: Check if local quantifiers are being treated as global without justification.
Check if relational identity is being collapsed into absolute object identity.
Check if standard logical equivalence is being used instead of recursive inseparability.
Check if incompleteness markers are being ignored or removed.
Check if finite-depth projections are assuming infinite-depth convergence.

governance_rules.rule: Every theorem package must declare its assumptions explicitly before review begins.
